title: When Semantic Segmentation Meets Frequency Aliasing
note: Variant: parameter-free de-aliasing filter before the stride-2 convs and max-pool of layer2/3/4, not before conv1. Run only if the grid-snap gate passes (the output is bound to the stride-2 grid); it tests the encoder side of the same grid bet. Code exists (Linwei-Chen/Seg-Aliasing). Cheap: no new parameters.

title: A Fourier-based Framework for Domain Generalization (FACT)
note: Arm gin_ipa (T7 arm 1, with P057 as fallback) already tests an intensity or spectrum style augmentation aimed at E1 and the weak sources; no code found for FACT; evidence is classification only, no segmentation or EL numbers. Reopen only if gin_ipa shows an effect.

title: Frequency-aware Feature Fusion for Dense Image Prediction (FreqFusion)
note: Variant: replace the upsample plus concat at the finest decoder node (x_0_3 / x_0_4) with FreqFusion, whose high-pass restores boundary detail. Same bet as fullres_detail_head (finest stage limits thin-line shape), so run only if the grid-snap gate passes or that arm passes. Code exists (Linwei-Chen/FreqFusion). No thin-structure numbers in the record.

title: Pasta: Proportional Amplitude Spectrum Training Augmentation
note: gin_ipa (T7 arm 1) is the named arm for shift-targeted input augmentation on E1; Pasta has no code found and its evidence is syn-to-real driving scenes. Cheap to write if gin_ipa passes, as a second augmentation row.

title: A principled representation of elongated structures using heatmaps
note: Arm thin_geometry_aux (FIDT head, rank 16) already trains a separate jitter-tolerant distance-style regression head with a pre-check pass; this heatmap is a close variant, and T2 soft_band_jml covers the soft band. No code, no crack test, numbers not read. Reopen if thin_geometry_aux passes and a per-source width filter is wanted.

title: PointScatter: Point Set Representation for Tubular Structure Extraction
note: Code exists, but it is a new output formulation (point sets, matching loss, rendering) needing a build well above the arms in the spec, while the mechanism that handles label jitter is already tested by thin_geometry_aux. Evidence is four vessel and road sets, no crack. Reopen only if both thin_geometry_aux and dti_hysteresis fail.

title: Wavelet Convolutions for Large Receptive Fields (WTConv)
note: Large-receptive-field encoder aimed at the E1 gap (half-cut layout, long scuff streaks, crack IoU 0.47 to 0.15). Not covered: no T5 arm changes the encoder context size, T6 and T11 test other backbones (foundation encoders, SegFormer, HRNet), and BRIEF 5 only ran a DINOv3 vs ImageNet ConvNeXt-T screen. Code and timm weights exist; drop-in WTConvNeXt-T under PF.

title: Revisiting Downsampling in Semantic Segmentation (dynamic Gaussian and Gabor filters)
note: Same aliasing mechanism as P056 and weaker evidence than it: no code found, numbers not read, a learnable Gabor selector adds build. If the de-aliasing variant of fullres_detail_head shows an effect, use its phase-error energy as a diagnostic then.

title: Frangi filter-based pretraining network for 3D cerebrovascular segmentation (FFPN)
note: Pool pretraining with a thin-structure target (multi-scale dark-ridge maps plus notch residual) on the whole U-Net++ then PF fine-tune. BRIEF 5 pool pretraining (MIM, DDeP) used other objectives and lists ridge or thin-structure objectives as open; T9 arms use teacher labels or foundation alignment, not ridge regression. Code exists (shigen-StoneRoot/FFPN). Check overlap with T9 before building.

title: Directional Connectivity Feature Enhancement Network for Pavement Crack Detection
note: Arm thin_geometry_aux (orientation head, rank 37) tests direction-aware training on the same crack skeleton, and T2 coletra_crack covers connectivity. No code found. Reopen as a loss variant of thin_geometry_aux only if that arm passes on component recall.

title: Edge-Boundary-Texture Loss: tri-class generalization of weighted BCE
note: T2 soft_band_jml tests a soft band near the label under a jitter-tolerant loss, which is the same mechanism (low weight on the ring beside the line); no code found, numbers not read. BRIEF 5 offset-tolerant CE (n.d.) is a related null at 10% labels so it does not close this, but the named arm comes first.

title: Frequency-Adaptive Dilated Convolution for Semantic Segmentation (FADC)
note: Code exists but the record has no thin-structure or small-data numbers, and it changes layer3/4 convolutions under PF, which interacts with encoder preservation. Weaker evidence than P220 for the same context-size goal (promoted). Reopen if P220 shows context helps on E1.

title: Wavelet and Prototype Augmented Query-based Transformer (WPFormer) for Pixel-level Surface Defect Detection
note: Recent pixel-level defect method with crack results (CrackSeg9k) and a mask-classification decoder, which was never run here (BRIEF 5). A baseline row for the benchmark suite (T11), not a tuned arm. Code location unverified (a WebSearch summary named yfhdm/WPFormer, not opened); confirm it before the suite freezes.

title: Deep Frequency Filtering for Domain Generalization
note: gin_ipa (T7 arm 1) is the named arm for E1 shift; DFF has no code found and classification and retrieval evidence only. Inserting FFT attention at layer2/3 also touches the encoder that PF preserves.

title: HoughNet-extended U-Net with reconstruction head for asphalt crack recall
note: Aimed at relR@2, which dti_hysteresis (recall at fixed precision, CPU only) tests first at zero GPU cost; no code found; pavement evidence only. Reopen if dti_hysteresis fails to lift relR@2.

title: GraphMorph: Tubular Structure Extraction by Morphing Predicted Graphs
note: Its use here (drop crack components not on a predicted branch) is a false-positive filter; dti_hysteresis and the component-precision readout cover post-processing first, and the record shows no code. Severity use is covered by the SAM-Road track (P482).

title: GaborNet: Gabor filters with learnable parameters
note: Parallel Gabor stem tests the same thing as the input arms crackcue_input and liot_input (a fixed oriented-filter cue next to raw), which also have CPU pre-checks; evidence is recognition datasets only; no code found. Reopen as a learned-cue variant if crackcue_input passes.

title: Segment Anything Model for Road Network Graph Extraction (SAM-Road)
note: Track for the benchmark's severity step (crack mode, length from a per-cell graph), not an IoU arm. Code exists (htcr/sam_road). Needs a crack graph label or a derived skeleton graph, so scope it with the severity design (T12) before any run.

title: SEMIR: Topology-Preserving Graph Minors for Thin-Structure Segmentation
note: No code linked, 2026 arXiv, numbers on power lines and CrackSeg9k only; needs a GNN and graph-minor build for a fragmentation gain that thin_geometry_aux (component recall) and dti_hysteresis test more cheaply.
